description: a folded paper parcel tied with coarse crossed twine and a round dark wax seal; three-quarter view; clearly a postal package, not a wooden trade chest
two long wooden water casks lashed together, visible curved staves and dark iron hoops
a cutaway timber ship bulkhead: thick vertical planks with a stout curved rib and cross-brace, freestanding section
a compact wooden shipboard bunk with a rolled blanket and pillow, clearly a sleeping berth
a short historical bronze swivel gun barrel with flared muzzle on its forked pivot and wooden rail mount
a curved cutaway ship hull section clad in three overlapping rows of copper sheathing plates with a few visible nail heads
a short mast and yard with a tightly reefed sail tied in three bands, two bold supporting ropes; storm-ready rigging
a fork-tailed merchant charter pennant flying from a short angled staff, with a tiny compass-star emblem; confident cloth folds
